payload.body:
0195 DESIGN REVIEW (dc, on vc's ask): PUBLISH works inside brew's build; the opt default needs a fixed root and an override; one HIGH -- a brew keg carries no ancestry, so no project is ever offered a brew release as an update. The full review, every line cited, is at ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-dc/0195/design-review.md; fold it into 0195's body if it should travel with the issue.

Read-only: the issue at 84b81a67, devbin at main, and Homebrew 7.0.9's source read as files. Nothing installed, tapped or run.

(1) PUBLISH IN BREW'S BUILD -- it should work.
- .git is staged (unpack_strategy/directory.rb:43-46). The clone is full, with no --depth (git_download_strategy.rb:70-83), and the tag's revision is verified at fetch.
- The tree stays clean. HOME is <buildpath>/.brew_home, and Homebrew writes .brew_home/.gitignore containing "*" for this case (formula.rb:3968-3979). The seam check is scoped to bin/devbin and lib/.
- git is on the build PATH through Homebrew's shims on both platforms, and the global git config is nulled (formula.rb:3890).
- The sandbox denies network and home reads (formula_installer.rb:1175, 1189, 1192), and PUBLISH needs neither. bin/brew drops XDG_DATA_HOME, and --prefix libexec is not install.prefix, so install_pointer_write writes nothing and returns 0 (lib/install:186-197).
- Linux is sandboxed too, through Landlock, so kovacs is not a sandbox-free control.
- depends_on "bash" is what passes the bash floor in the build (extend/ENV/super.rb:189-195). Never pin the shebang in the keg: the manifest checksums the copied bytes, and install --into would vendor that path into projects.
- Unchecked, since nothing was run: whether devbin writes an untracked, unignored file before the gate. The local rehearsal answers it.

(2) THE opt DEFAULT
- ROOT: it must be <prefix>/opt/devbin/libexec, not opt/devbin. machine_install_state reads kind: install from that root's manifest (lib/helpers:3231-3242), and Intent records opt/intent/libexec for the same reason.
- FINDING THE PREFIX is unspecified. I suggest fixed candidates (/opt/homebrew, /usr/local, /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew, ~/.linuxbrew) behind ONE overriding variable, with doctor naming what chose it. HOMEBREW_PREFIX is missing outside a brew shellenv shell, and brew --prefix is a subprocess on the notice's path.
- [HIGH] NO ANCESTRY IN A BREW KEG. install_ancestry seeds its table from the manifest already at the target (lib/install:1390-1405). Every brew version is a new keg, so the table is empty, and install_direction answers unknown (lib/helpers:3533-3557). After every brew upgrade:
  - upgrade warns "cannot tell whether ... ahead of or BEHIND" (lib/cmd/upgrade:422-431);
  - the notice prints "differs ... not known to be newer; run: devbin vendor" in place of UPDATE (lib/helpers:3870-3874);
  - doctor says "differs" (lib/cmd/doctor:770-774).
  Every estate recording 7c39d91c reads the same way at the rollout. The proof as written ("still finds it") cannot see this. Self-refuted: a new versioned keg holds no prior manifest.
  Options: (a) PUBLISH seeds its table from the previous install. The build may read HOMEBREW_PREFIX (sandbox.rb:426-430), opt should still name the old keg while the new one builds (to confirm), and the full clone can place each commit. That covers brew to brew, but not 7c39d91c. (b) Seed the table from the release tags reachable from HEAD; that misses commits off a tag. Either way, the proof asserts forward and UPDATE.
- [MEDIUM] shell-init BAKES THE VERSIONED KEG INTO dvb. Run from an install, it answers PROJECT_ROOT (lib/cmd/shell-init:195-199), and bin/devbin resolves that with cd -P to Cellar/devbin/<v>/libexec (bin/devbin:35-45). After brew cleanup that is the 0527 class. The eval form heals at the next shell; --autoload does not.
- [MEDIUM] TEST ISOLATION. devbin_isolate_machine moves only XDG_DATA_HOME (tests/lib/test_helper.bash:195-197). Once brew holds devbin on hv's Mac or kovacs, arms that expect "names none" find the real install, go red there, and stay green on CI. Line counts for that phrasing: machinepointer.bats 7, shellinit.bats 3, dispatch.bats 1, fleet.bats 1. The fix is the override variable, which the helper points at an empty directory.
- [MEDIUM] install.prefix FIGHTS BREW AFTER THE ROLLOUT. A checkout publish to install.prefix rewrites the pointer (lib/install:182-217, through lib/cmd/install:423 and lib/cmd/upgrade:155), which undoes the repoint without saying so. fleet refuses unless the machine names install.prefix (bin/.devbin/cmd/fleet:948-972), and its remedy is that same publish. Setting install.prefix to the brew path would publish into the keg. hv's call.
- [LOW] At the rollout, never write the pointer through install_pointer_write or physical_dir. Both resolve with cd -P (lib/install:203, lib/helpers:597-599) and would record the Cellar path. Delete the home line instead, or write the opt path verbatim.
- [LOW] On this Mac the proof proves the pointer, not the default, because hv's home line wins, unless that arm runs with an empty XDG_DATA_HOME. kovacs proves the default.
- [LOW] There is no brew-ownership mark like Utilz's --managed-by, so upgrade --prefix <keg> from a checkout would write bytes brew owns.

(3) WHILE PRIVATE
- Fetches never prompt: GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0, and SSH_ASKPASS is forced to false (git_download_strategy.rb:99-105). A fetch works only through a credential helper or an ssh agent.
- https: the fetch reads the user's git config with the real HOME (101-102; the home is readable apart from a denylist, sandbox.rb:441-483), so osxkeychain works here. GH_TOKEN is passed only with HOMEBREW_GITHUB_API_TOKEN set, gh on PATH, an https url and a configured credential.helper (110-121). On kovacs that means gh auth setup-git plus the token.
- ssh: the scp form matches no detector pattern (download_strategy_detector.rb:36-43). Use ssh://git@github.com/..., or using: :git. A key with a passphrase works only through the agent.
- The url is baked into the formula, and an ssh url fails for the public once devbin goes public. Keep https, or switch when it goes public; hv's call.
- Also needs credentials while private: a private tap (brew tap and every upgrade), and livecheck, bump and audit --online, which get 404s from GitHub's API. Not affected: the build and the test block, which run offline.

D55: agreed. A git url stages the tree itself and needs no asset; integrity is the tag plus revision pin.

Not read: lib/cmd/vendor, the release core and its after: step, devbin's config.yaml (so the issue's :38-46 is unverified), Homebrew's Landlock rules, and its reinstall, link and bottle code.
